tabular.purpose: Every numeric value: rank, margin, volume, quality score, plata/dia, derivation figures.

components.name: Recipe Row
components.description: Full-width toggle button showing rank, name, tier badge, margin/volume stats, quality bar, and the amber plata/dia figure; expands an inline derivation panel on click.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 8%); color: oklch(0.94 0.003 285); text-align: left; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.25 0.004 285) 40%, transparent); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.16 68); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-rank { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); } .ds-row-name { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-tier { margin-left: 6px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.25 0.004 285); font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; } .ds-row-stat { text-align: right; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row-stat em { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; } .ds-row-money { text-align: right; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: oklch(0.78 0.16 68); } .ds-row-money em { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); }

components.name: Quality Bar
components.description: Thin horizontal bar chip signaling data-quality score strength, not a pass/fail badge.
components.css: .ds-quality { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-quality-track { width: 40px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.23 0.004 285); overflow: hidden; } .ds-quality-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.78 0.16 68); } .ds-quality-score { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); }

components.name: Sort Chip (mobile)
components.description: Pill-shaped sort toggle for the mobile fallback bar; active state carries the amber accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip ds-chip-active">Plata/dia <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M19 12l-7 7-7-7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 8%); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); font-family: 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-active { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.78 0.16 68) 50%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.78 0.16 68) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.78 0.16 68); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.16 68); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sticky Page Header
components.description: Sticky, blurred title block used at the top of every Operate-mode page.
components.html:
Alquimia -- Americas

Ranking por plata realizable por dia.
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 8%); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.14 0.003 285) 95%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-header-title { font-family: 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.94 0.003 285); margin: 0; } .ds-header-sub { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.62 0.006 285); }

narrative.overview: PlataRank is a single-purpose Operate surface, not a marketing page: a near-black ground read one-handed next to the game, where the only color statement is a warm amber reserved for the number that matters. The build confirms the direction contract's thesis exactly -- plata/dia renders as the largest, only-colored figure in each row (text-money, font-mono, text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold), while margin and volume sit as small muted stats stacked beside it. There is no hero, no marketing copy, no light mode: <html class="dark"> is hardcoded in the root layout, confirming dark-only is a real product decision, not a default left unconfigured. Density and legibility drive every layout call: hairline borders instead of shadows, a virtualized row list tuned to a 52px estimate, and tabular-nums monospace on every number so columns hold their alignment while scrolling fast on a phone. The system does not reach for icons, badges, or color to create hierarchy where restraint already does the job -- the one amber accent is rationed to two roles and never leaks into buttons or navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only "Operate ground" -- no light theme exists or is planned.
One accent color, two jobs: the plata/dia figure and active sort state. Nothing else uses it.
Tabular-nums monospace on every numeric value; proportional sans on every label.
Zero shadows; hairline borders and tonal surface steps carry all separation.
Dense, mobile-first row rhythm with an expandable inline detail panel per row.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: The accent is rationed to the plata/dia figure and active sort state. A retry button, a badge, or a nav item never carries it -- confirmed by the error page's retry button, which uses a plain hairline border and hover:bg-accent, not the money color.

rules.name: The Tabular-Nums Rule
rules.body: Any value that is a quantity (silver, percent, count, score) renders in mono with tabular-nums; any value that is a label or name renders in the proportional sans. Never mix the two roles for legibility's sake.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation is never simulated with box-shadow. Use a border and/or the next tonal surface step instead.

dos: Do reserve the money-amber accent for realized/ranked silver figures and active sort/filter state only.
Do render every quantity (price, percent, count, score) in mono with tabular-nums; render every name/label in proportional sans.
Do use hairline borders and tonal surface steps for separation and depth; never a shadow.
Do pair any new sortable/filterable control with both a desktop inline-header form and a mobile chip-bar form, per the confirmed responsive split.
Do keep new ranked-list surfaces (Fase 2 city controls, Fase 3 station types) on the row + expandable-detail pattern rather than introducing a details page or modal.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme variant; dark-only is a confirmed product decision (<html class="dark"> is hardcoded), not an unfinished default.
Don't render a data-quality or confidence score as a colored badge or traffic-light; the thin horizontal bar is the system's only quality-signal device.
Don't spread the amber accent onto buttons, nav, or non-ranking UI -- it stays rationed to the two roles above.
Don't add box-shadows for elevation; step to the next tonal surface or add a hairline border instead.
